title: Correction receipt — the supersession primitive
rules: every correction references the receipt it supersedes by contentId
the verify surface always resolves the HEAD of a supersession chain
corrections publish in the same record as results, signed

fields.supersedes: contentId or artifact identifier of the superseded artifact
fields.reason_code: one of: factual-error | identity-error | overclaim | stale-version | security-rotation | process-fix
fields.evidence: what changed and how a third party checks it
